name: Rule Palm
description: Strike with the open palm while order qi squares the blow along one true line into the opponent's chest.

name: Plumbed Guard
description: Hold both forearms level and spread order qi evenly across them so a blow meets one steady surface.

name: Measured Step
description: Take one pace of exact length with the weight kept level so the next strike is ready at once.

name: Straight Thrust
description: Drive two joined fingers along a straight path with qi aligned behind them to pierce one point on the body.

name: Steady Breath
description: Draw breath in counted portions so the user's own qi flows regular and the next strikes land cleaner.

name: Fixed Stance
description: Settle into a square stance and lock the frame with order qi so pushes and shoves find no give.

name: Pace Strike
description: Land a punch exactly as the forward foot lands so the full pace of the body rides into the blow.

name: Level Walk
description: Walk forward in even paces with the head and hips held level so the user never loses balance on rough footing.

name: Turning Square
description: Pivot on the ball of one foot through a quarter turn and set the body square to a new target.

name: Cadence Fist
description: Throw a fist on the beat of a counted rhythm so the opponent cannot read when it will land.

name: Even Deflect
description: Sweep a punch wide with a flat forearm so its force passes the body along a smooth line.

name: Pace Count
description: Count the footfalls of those nearby through the ground to know how many approach and how heavily they walk.

name: Rhythm Kick
description: Snap a low kick at the shin timed to the opponent's own step so the leg gives way.

name: Plumb Sense
description: Feel along a wall or a beam with order qi to find where it leans or has begun to fail.

name: Crooked Eye
description: Read an opponent's stance in a glance to find which limb is out of line and carries the least strength.

name: Dictum Strike
description: Drop a straight downward blow along the vertical line of the target's balance to break its footing.

name: Flat Ward
description: Hold a flat plane of order qi before the chest that shrugs off glancing blows without tilting.

name: True Reach
description: Flick a bolt of qi along a perfectly straight line to strike a target at a short distance.

name: Held Measure
description: Hold a fixed measure of qi across the arms and let no blow push it above or below that measure.

name: Order Grip
description: Close a hand on the opponent's wrist and lay qi along the arm so the limb will not twist free.

name: Rule Block
description: Meet a strike with the forearm at the one angle that turns it away and costs the user nothing.

name: Squared Palm
description: Strike with the heel of a squared hand so the whole width of the palm lands at once.

name: Fast Knot
description: Wind a thread of order qi round the opponent's ankle and draw it fixed so the step stalls.

name: Fixed Pace
description: Cover a set distance in one pace whose length never varies so the user can plan the next move.

name: Weighed Blow
description: Send a blow weighed to the exact force needed to drop a guard without overreaching.

name: Calm Measure
description: Measure the user's qi into steady portions so each later move draws no more than it needs.

name: Tally Strike
description: Count a short run of three blows and loose each on its number so none is wasted.

name: Breath Count
description: Count each breath in and out so the reserve of qi spends slowly and the user tires later.

name: Tally Step
description: Step forward and back in a fixed count so the user always knows how much ground remains behind.

name: Number Jab
description: Jab a pointed knuckle at the same spot on the body three times in a tight counted run.

name: Counted Guard
description: Raise a guard on the count of the opponent's swing so it arrives just as the blow does.

name: Exact Spend
description: Release one exact portion of qi into the next strike so it lands harder without a wasted surge.

name: Settled Pulse
description: Slow and even out the pulse of the user's qi so a shaken body finds its rhythm again.

name: Quiet Frame
description: Sit the body into a still frame of order qi that no light blow or shout can unsettle.

name: Quiet Palm
description: Press a calm open palm into the opponent's chest so the force lands flat and carries through.

name: Still Step
description: Slide one foot forward without lifting the body so the shift in position gives no warning.

name: Pattern Read
description: Watch an opponent's first few blows and find the repeating pattern so the next can be met early.

name: Level Turn
description: Turn the body a half step and let a straight attack slide past along the flat of the arm.

name: Settle Strike
description: Sink the weight and strike low so the blow lands with the full settled mass of the user behind it.

name: Loosen Knot
description: Touch a tangled hold and lay its strands straight so the grip on the user falls away.

name: Straight Pull
description: Draw the opponent's arm out into a straight line with order qi so it cannot bend or swing.

name: Unsnarl
description: Shake loose a tangle of loose qi around the user so a clumsy binding technique unravels at once.

name: Aligned Strike
description: Strike a bent limb along its straightened line so the joint locks and the blow bites deep.

name: Smooth Thread
description: Draw the user's scattered qi into one smooth thread so each move afterward runs without a hitch.

name: Square Frame
description: Raise a small square frame of order qi before the body that turns a blow along its edge.

name: Edge Turn
description: Angle the frame so a heavy strike glances along its edge and spends itself in the air.

name: Frame Push
description: Drive the raised frame forward as a flat wall of qi to shove the opponent back a pace.

name: Corner Mark
description: Set four points of qi at the corners of a space and feel anything that crosses between them.

name: Corner Pace
description: Step along the lines of a square so each pace lands where the last frame's edge ended.

name: Braced Frame
description: Brace the frame with a second layer of qi so it holds against repeated heavy blows.
